sentences.text: Paleopsilopterus was a large, flightless, predatory bird.
The genus Paleopsilopterus was described by Alvarenga in 1985.
Fossils of the only known species, P. itaboraiensis, were found in the Itaboraí Formation near São José de Itaborai, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
Paleopsilopterus belongs to the order Cariamiformes.
The genus is generally placed in the subfamily Psilopterinae and the family Phorusrhacidae.
The precise taxonomic placement of Paleopsilopterus remains debated.
The animal lived specifically within the Itaboraian South American Land Mammal Age.
The time range for the genus is the Ypresian stage, from 56 to 48.07 million years ago.
